errors.text: The proposed grain-boundary nucleation route is incompatible with the bulk periodic single-crystal model unless grain boundaries were deliberately introduced.
The predicted 15–20% orientation-dependent yield-stress difference is unsupported by the target or cited evidence.

Persistence or disappearance during annealing is not a definitive discriminator between a stacking fault and an HCP phase, because stacking faults may remain kinetically trapped and a transformed phase may revert.
